text:
aisha_cs: Kicking off Sunrise onboarding thread. Quick frame: success = hosted prod inference SLO p95 <300ms, secure ingest + keys, first customer demo by week 6. Confirm stakeholders and blockers?

ben_ae: I9m account lead. Customer stakeholders: Evan (infra), Priya (security), Maya (product). I9ll email intros after this thread.

carlos_pm: Product priorities: (1) prompt routing with Redwood API, (2) basic cost cards in Console.

dina_se: SE needs API key, sample dataset, schema for embed/rerank. @evan_it can you share S3 or allowlist?

ev an_it: evan_it: I9ll provision a staging S3 and open a VPC/KMS ticket. Security wants to vet keys first. ETA docs: EOD Tue.

frank_success: Proposed timeline: week0 kickoff, week1 infra & keys, week2 model routing + tests, week3 embed index + evals, week4 canary/demo, week6 full demo + signoff. Renewal touchpoint at week8 if not live.

aisha_cs: Two asks: 1) SE-led enablement sessions (60m) for customer devs; 2) weekly pulse feedback + shared doc for blockers.

dina_se: I can run sessions. Slots next Tue/Thu 10am PT. Agenda: API call, streaming, tool-calls, cost controls.

ben_ae: @aisha_cs add invites and include customer calendar. I9ll own renewal check-ins.

carlos_pm: Capture success metrics: p95 <300ms, embedding recall >0.7 on eval set, deploy automation for model pinning+rollback. Add to playbook.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: shared doc created at https://docs.redwood.ai/sunrise/onboard

aisha_cs: Weekly pulse = 3 q: ease-of-integration, latency acceptability, blockers. Frank will collate Fridays.

ev an_it: Security note (Priya): customer KMS required for private keys. Adds ~5 business days to infra prep. Flagging.

frank_success: Action items:
- ben_ae: intro email to customer stakeholders (today)
- evan_it: share S3 + KMS constraints (EOD Tue)
- dina_se: prep SE session deck + sample calls (Mon)
- carlos_pm: upload eval set + thresholds to playbook (Wed)
- aisha_cs: create weekly pulse doc + cadence (today)

ben_ae: If KMS delays infra, propose swapping week2/3 so we can test routing on hosted variant earlier.

aisha_cs: Agreed 12 plan hosted fallback in week2 if private prep delays. Keeps demo timeline.

dina_se: SE session config snippet to include:
```
# sample curl for test call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

carlos_pm: Risk: if cost dashboard gating isn't ready, we9ll demo manual CSV export. Acceptable for signoff but not ideal.

aisha_cs: Please react with :thumbsup: once you confirm timeline/roles; I9ll send kickoff summary.

ben_ae: :thumbsup:

carlos_pm: :thumbsup:

dina_se: :thumbsup:

ev an_it: :thumbsup:

frank_success: Logged actions in playbook and pinged SRE for VPC/KMS. Will update with calendar invites.

aisha_cs: Closing thread for now 12 will follow up with summary and invites. DM for urgent items. Thanks!
